## Highlights
### Improved
- On Mac, a Quick Window that opens where another already is opens a little below and to the right of it, so both stay in view.
### Fixed
- On Mac, a Quick Window for a link from another app opens over the window you're in and on its display, instead of over a Crest window that may be on another display, and comes to the Space you're on. - On Mac, Command-` (Move focus to next window) moves between Crest's windows, Quick Windows included, when a Chromium page has focus. - On Mac, a link from another app that opens a Quick Window already open for it brings that Quick Window to the window you're in, and Quick Windows opening at a screen's edge no longer open on top of each other. - On Mac, a Quick Window for a link from a window that spans two displays opens on the display you're using and fits on it.
---
Development builds contain the newest changes and may be less reliable than stable releases.

## Highlights
### Fixed
- Downloads follow the Automatic Downloads choice of the site you’re on, including files it serves from another address, such as GitHub release files. A blocked download’s message no longer appears twice. - Chromium pages use your default zoom when they open and keep your chosen zoom as you navigate. - Chromium is updated to 154.0.8037.57 with upstream security and compatibility fixes.
